title: Roy and Barbara Goodman Family Professor of the Practice of Diplomacy and International Relations
affiliation: Roy and Barbara Goodman Family Professor of the Practice of Diplomacy and International Relations
bio: Ambassador Nicholas Burns is the Roy and Barbara Goodman Family Professor of the Practice of Diplomacy and International Relations at Harvard University’s Kennedy School of Government. He is the Founder and Faculty Chair of the Future of Diplomacy Project. He is also a Faculty Affiliate at Harvard’s Fairbank Center for Chinese Studies.
